The exact physical-time quadrature after x=Au gives scaled period 2sqrt(2) int exp(q*u^4/4)/sqrt(I_q+epsilon*J_q)du. I_q/J_q is the q-exponential tilt expectation of r^4 on [u,1], hence nondecreasing in q; at q=0 it equals (1+u^2+u^4)/3 >=1/3. This proves the novel global J/I<=3 for all q,u, and two-sided period bound uniformly even q=alpha*A^4 -> infinity. Direct logarithmic differentiation gives strict Phi decrease; endpoint beta integral and q(1-u) layer dominated convergence give 2pi and turning-layer density. The normalized quarter-time integral proves physical occupation. Independent symbolic conservation, 20 tilt kernel comparisons, and verified RESULT/code paths corroborate, not replace these infinite proofs. Boundary beta=0 is excluded; q is nonnegative, A>0.
